3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

Materials
The sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ , 99.8% min), diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2, 99.8% min) and 2-methyloxolane (MO, 99.8% min) were purchased from DoDo Chem. Common ether electrolyte (CCE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2 solvent. Weakly solvated electrolyte (WSE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in MO solvent. Co-intercalated electrolyte (CIE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2: MO = 7:3 vol%. All electrolyte preparation processes were carried out in a glovebox filled with Ar (H $_2$ O < 0.1 ppm and O $_2$ < 0.1 ppm). The electrolyte salts and solvents we purchased are of anhydrous grade. After purchase, they are placed in the glove box for direct use.

Hard carbon (HC) materials were purchased from Baisige New Energy Co., Ltd. The HC negative electrode was prepared by mixing the active material, CMC (CMC2200, purchased from Daicel Corporation), SBR (BM-451B, purchased from Zeon Corporation) and conductive carbon black (weight ratio 92:1.5:3.5:3) in deionized water to form a homogeneous slurry. The slurry was spread on a copper foil (thickness 18 $\mu$ m) and dried at 80 °C for 8–12 h. Then, it was perforated into a circular electrode sheet with a diameter of 12 mm and a loading of 2.5–3.0 mg cm $^{-2}$ . Glass fiber (GF/D, Whatman) was used as separator and metallic sodium (purchased from Canrd Technology Co. Ltd.) was used as counter electrode. These components were assembled with HC negative electrode to assemble Na ||HC coin cells. The diameter of the glass fiber is 16 mm and the thickness is 0.68 mm. The diameter of the sodium metal electrode is 15.6 mm and the thickness is 0.4 mm.

The Ah-level pouch batteries were composed of O3-NaNi $_{1/3}$ Fe $_{1/3}$ Mn $_{1/3}$ O $_{2}$ (NFM) positive electrode and HC negative electrode coated on Al foil. The specific details and parameters are shown in Table S7.

citations.quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

citations.quote: To evaluate the electrochemical performance of the electrolyte, Na $^{+}$ HC cells were assembled. The structural characteristics of HC are shown in Fig. S13, and for HC, the reversible capacity during the first cycle is critical for less sodium loss. As shown in Fig. 3a, CIE provides a specific capacity of 300.5 mAh g $^{-1}$ and an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% during the first cycle at 25°C, while CCE and WSE provide specific capacities of 299.6 and 300.1 mAh g $^{-1}$ and ICE of 87.7% and 91.4%, respectively. The three electrolytes deliver similar reversible capacities, while CIE has the highest ICE. The severe electrolyte decomposition creates a thick SEI and affects ICE $^{30,31}$ , which may explain the lower ICE of CCE. For CIE and WSE, the introduction of anions enables the construction of inorganic-rich SEI, and the appropriate number of anions in CIE consumes less Na $^{+}$ during film formation, thus guaranteeing a high ICE for HC in CIE. The rate performance of HC is shown in Figure S14, where CIE still provides a specific capacity of $195.0 \, mAh g^{-1}$ at $2 \, A g^{-1}$ , while CCE and WSE maintain a specific capacity of 204.6 and $131.4 \, mAh g^{-1}$ , respectively. This phenomenon suggests that the ionic conductivity plays a crucial role in the rate performance at $25^{\circ}C$ . The CIE effectively improves the ionic conductivity while retaining the co-intercalation behavior, so the rate performance is close to that of CCE.

citations.quote: Herein, we design a co-intercalation electrolyte (CIE) toward HC negative electrode, successfully overcoming the trade-off between $Na^{+}$ desolvation and ionic conductivity in electrolyte. Our CIE allows ions to bypass the slow desolvation process at interface and achieve sufficient diffusion in electrolyte and HC simultaneously. The free solvent regulation significantly widens the operating temperature of CIE to $-50^{\circ}C$ while ensuring sufficient solvent co-intercalation for ion storage. Meanwhile, the precisely regulated solvation structure enables appropriate participation of anions in the solvation sheath, resulting in the formation of a thinner, inorganic-rich SEI. This interphase facilitates efficient $Na^{+}$ transport across the SEI. As a result, our CIE greatly improves the low temperature performance of HC negative electrode and is further demonstrated in Ah-level SIBs cell pack. Typically, the Na ||HC cell using CIE has an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% at $25^{\circ}C$ , and an ICE of 80.5% even at the low temperature of $-50^{\circ}C$ , achieving a performance improvement compared to the existing electrolytes for HC. The CIE empowers the HC to deliver a capacity retention of 93.5% after 200 cycles at $-50^{\circ}C$ . Further assembled Ah-level HC || $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) pouch cell can achieve specific energy of $163 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ}C$ and $107 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $-50^{\circ}C$ .

citations.quote: $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ , carbon nanotubes (CNTs), polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), and carbon black with the mass ratio of 92.5: 2.0: 3.5: 2.0 were mixed in pyrrolidone to form a uniform slurry, and then coated on a 14 um thick aluminum foil to prepare the cathode electrode. The areal density was measured to be 10.0 mg cm $^{-2}$ , and the compacted density was 2.1 g cm $^{-3}$ . To prepare the anode electrode, hard carbon (Kuraray), carbon black, cellulose sodium (CMC), and styrene butadiene rubber (SBR) with the mass ratio of 94.5: 1.0: 2.0: 2.5 were added in deionized water and stirred into a uniform slurry, and then coated on a 9 um thick copper foil with the areal and compacted densities of 4.31 mg cm $^{-2}$ and 1.4 g cm $^{-3}$ , respectively. The cathode, anode, and separator (20 μm polypropylene) were assembled into pouch cells with a designed capacity of 650 mAh, and the thickness, width, and length were 10, 68, and 127 mm, respectively. The cells were dried in vacuum (-99 kPa/80 °C) until the water content was less than 150 ppm. At a dewpoint of -40 °C, the electrolytes defined as G1, G2, G3, and G4 (Table 1) were injected into the cells. After packaging in vacuum at room temperature for 48 hours; the pouch cells were placed at the environment with 0.8 MPa and 45 °C and charged at 0.05 C for 180 min, followed by another charge at a constant current of 0.1 C for 360 min.

2.1. Preparation of electrolytes
Sodium tetrakis[3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]borate (NaTFPB, 99 % purity, sourced from Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd.) were acquired as functional additives. Prior to their utilization, these additives underwent a rigorous freeze-drying process under vacuum conditions at $-80^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for a duration of $24\mathrm{h}$ to remove $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$ . The Base electrolyte was prepared by dissolving sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6, 1.0\mathrm{mol}\mathrm{L}^{-1})$ in a mixture of ethylene carbonate (EC) and dimethyl carbonate (DMC) (at a mass ratio of 1:1) containing $5.0\%$ fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC). The Base electrolyte serves as the reference for comparing the effect of the additive on the electrochemical performance of the cells. To formulate electrolytes containing functional additives, NaTFPB was added to the Base electrolyte at various concentrations, as illustrated in Fig. S1. All electrolyte preparations were carried out within an argon-filled glovebox environment, which was rigorously maintained to ensure that both water and oxygen levels were kept below $0.01~\mathrm{ppm}$ , thereby safeguarding the integrity and purity of the electrolytes.

3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

citations.quote:
3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

2.1. Preparation of electrolytes
Sodium tetrakis[3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]borate (NaTFPB, 99 % purity, sourced from Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd.) were acquired as functional additives. Prior to their utilization, these additives underwent a rigorous freeze-drying process under vacuum conditions at $-80^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for a duration of $24\mathrm{h}$ to remove $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$ . The Base electrolyte was prepared by dissolving sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6, 1.0\mathrm{mol}\mathrm{L}^{-1})$ in a mixture of ethylene carbonate (EC) and dimethyl carbonate (DMC) (at a mass ratio of 1:1) containing $5.0\%$ fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC). The Base electrolyte serves as the reference for comparing the effect of the additive on the electrochemical performance of the cells. To formulate electrolytes containing functional additives, NaTFPB was added to the Base electrolyte at various concentrations, as illustrated in Fig. S1. All electrolyte preparations were carried out within an argon-filled glovebox environment, which was rigorously maintained to ensure that both water and oxygen levels were kept below $0.01~\mathrm{ppm}$ , thereby safeguarding the integrity and purity of the electrolytes.

evidence_ledger.quote: Herein, we design a co-intercalation electrolyte (CIE) toward HC negative electrode, successfully overcoming the trade-off between $Na^{+}$ desolvation and ionic conductivity in electrolyte. Our CIE allows ions to bypass the slow desolvation process at interface and achieve sufficient diffusion in electrolyte and HC simultaneously. The free solvent regulation significantly widens the operating temperature of CIE to $-50^{\circ}C$ while ensuring sufficient solvent co-intercalation for ion storage. Meanwhile, the precisely regulated solvation structure enables appropriate participation of anions in the solvation sheath, resulting in the formation of a thinner, inorganic-rich SEI. This interphase facilitates efficient $Na^{+}$ transport across the SEI. As a result, our CIE greatly improves the low temperature performance of HC negative electrode and is further demonstrated in Ah-level SIBs cell pack. Typically, the Na ||HC cell using CIE has an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% at $25^{\circ}C$ , and an ICE of 80.5% even at the low temperature of $-50^{\circ}C$ , achieving a performance improvement compared to the existing electrolytes for HC. 3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

citations.quote: To evaluate the electrochemical performance of the electrolyte, Na $^{+}$ HC cells were assembled. The structural characteristics of HC are shown in Fig. S13, and for HC, the reversible capacity during the first cycle is critical for less sodium loss. As shown in Fig. 3a, CIE provides a specific capacity of 300.5 mAh g $^{-1}$ and an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% during the first cycle at 25°C, while CCE and WSE provide specific capacities of 299.6 and 300.1 mAh g $^{-1}$ and ICE of 87.7% and 91.4%, respectively. The three electrolytes deliver similar reversible capacities, while CIE has the highest ICE. The severe electrolyte decomposition creates a thick SEI and affects ICE $^{30,31}$ , which may explain the lower ICE of CCE. For CIE and WSE, the introduction of anions enables the construction of inorganic-rich SEI, and the appropriate number of anions in CIE consumes less Na $^{+}$ during film formation, thus guaranteeing a high ICE for HC in CIE. The rate performance of HC is shown in Figure S14, where CIE still provides a specific capacity of $195.0 \, mAh g^{-1}$ at $2 \, A g^{-1}$ , while CCE and WSE maintain a specific capacity of 204.6 and $131.4 \, mAh g^{-1}$ , respectively. This phenomenon suggests that the ionic conductivity plays a crucial role in the rate performance at $25^{\circ}C$ . The CIE effectively improves the ionic conductivity while retaining the co-intercalation behavior, so the rate performance is close to that of CCE.

citations.quote: Herein, we design a co-intercalation electrolyte (CIE) toward HC negative electrode, successfully overcoming the trade-off between $Na^{+}$ desolvation and ionic conductivity in electrolyte. Our CIE allows ions to bypass the slow desolvation process at interface and achieve sufficient diffusion in electrolyte and HC simultaneously. The free solvent regulation significantly widens the operating temperature of CIE to $-50^{\circ}C$ while ensuring sufficient solvent co-intercalation for ion storage. Meanwhile, the precisely regulated solvation structure enables appropriate participation of anions in the solvation sheath, resulting in the formation of a thinner, inorganic-rich SEI. This interphase facilitates efficient $Na^{+}$ transport across the SEI. As a result, our CIE greatly improves the low temperature performance of HC negative electrode and is further demonstrated in Ah-level SIBs cell pack. Typically, the Na ||HC cell using CIE has an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% at $25^{\circ}C$ , and an ICE of 80.5% even at the low temperature of $-50^{\circ}C$ , achieving a performance improvement compared to the existing electrolytes for HC. The CIE empowers the HC to deliver a capacity retention of 93.5% after 200 cycles at $-50^{\circ}C$ . Further assembled Ah-level HC || $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) pouch cell can achieve specific energy of $163 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ}C$ and $107 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $-50^{\circ}C$ .

Abstract: A commercially feasible sodium-ion pouch cell with a capacity of 650 mAh is fabricated using the ternary layered $\mathrm{Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_2}$ and the hard carbon as the cathode and anode materials, respectively. $1.0\mathrm{MNaPF}_6$ in the mixed carbonate solvents is served as the electrolyte. citations.quote: In summary, a commercially feasible sodium-ion pouch cell with $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon is fabricated in this work. According to the calculation of the frontier molecular orbital energy, the electrolyte additive adiponitrile (ADN) is selected as the electrolyte additive to improve the performance of sodium-ion battery for the first time, and the effects of the ADN on the performance improvement of the cathode material $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ are investigated for the first time. The results show that ADN can promote the formation of highly conductive and stable SEI film on the cathode material surface, and effectively improve the high-low-temperature performance and cycling stability of $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ as the cathode electrode material of sodium-ion batteries. In particular, the battery with 3% ADN shows the most obvious improvement, its discharge capacity increases by 10.5%, 8%, and 13% at the operating temperature of 45, -10, and -20 °C, respectively. For the cycling stability, the capacity retention rate of the battery without adding ADN drops rapidly to 75% after 40 cycles, while the capacity retention rate of the battery with 3% ADN can still reach 78% after 220 cycles. Adding ADN as electrolyte additive effectively improves the electrochemical performance of sodium ion batteries.

citations.quote: In summary, a commercially feasible sodium-ion pouch cell with $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon is fabricated in this work. According to the calculation of the frontier molecular orbital energy, the electrolyte additive adiponitrile (ADN) is selected as the electrolyte additive to improve the performance of sodium-ion battery for the first time, and the effects of the ADN on the performance improvement of the cathode material $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ are investigated for the first time. The results show that ADN can promote the formation of highly conductive and stable SEI film on the cathode material surface, and effectively improve the high-low-temperature performance and cycling stability of $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ as the cathode electrode material of sodium-ion batteries. In particular, the battery with 3% ADN shows the most obvious improvement, its discharge capacity increases by 10.5%, 8%, and 13% at the operating temperature of 45, -10, and -20 °C, respectively. For the cycling stability, the capacity retention rate of the battery without adding ADN drops rapidly to 75% after 40 cycles, while the capacity retention rate of the battery with 3% ADN can still reach 78% after 220 cycles. Adding ADN as electrolyte additive effectively improves the electrochemical performance of sodium ion batteries.

2.1. Preparation of electrolytes
Sodium tetrakis[3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]borate (NaTFPB, 99 % purity, sourced from Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co., Ltd.) were acquired as functional additives. Prior to their utilization, these additives underwent a rigorous freeze-drying process under vacuum conditions at $-80^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for a duration of $24\mathrm{h}$ to remove $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$ . The Base electrolyte was prepared by dissolving sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6, 1.0\mathrm{mol}\mathrm{L}^{-1})$ in a mixture of ethylene carbonate (EC) and dimethyl carbonate (DMC) (at a mass ratio of 1:1) containing $5.0\%$ fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC). The Base electrolyte serves as the reference for comparing the effect of the additive on the electrochemical performance of the cells. To formulate electrolytes containing functional additives, NaTFPB was added to the Base electrolyte at various concentrations, as illustrated in Fig. S1. All electrolyte preparations were carried out within an argon-filled glovebox environment, which was rigorously maintained to ensure that both water and oxygen levels were kept below $0.01~\mathrm{ppm}$ , thereby safeguarding the integrity and purity of the electrolytes.

3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

citations.quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

citations.quote: Herein, we design a co-intercalation electrolyte (CIE) toward HC negative electrode, successfully overcoming the trade-off between $Na^{+}$ desolvation and ionic conductivity in electrolyte. Our CIE allows ions to bypass the slow desolvation process at interface and achieve sufficient diffusion in electrolyte and HC simultaneously. The free solvent regulation significantly widens the operating temperature of CIE to $-50^{\circ}C$ while ensuring sufficient solvent co-intercalation for ion storage. Meanwhile, the precisely regulated solvation structure enables appropriate participation of anions in the solvation sheath, resulting in the formation of a thinner, inorganic-rich SEI. This interphase facilitates efficient $Na^{+}$ transport across the SEI. As a result, our CIE greatly improves the low temperature performance of HC negative electrode and is further demonstrated in Ah-level SIBs cell pack. Typically, the Na ||HC cell using CIE has an initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of 93.7% at $25^{\circ}C$ , and an ICE of 80.5% even at the low temperature of $-50^{\circ}C$ , achieving a performance improvement compared to the existing electrolytes for HC. The CIE empowers the HC to deliver a capacity retention of 93.5% after 200 cycles at $-50^{\circ}C$ . Further assembled Ah-level HC || $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) pouch cell can achieve specific energy of $163 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ}C$ and $107 Wh kg^{-1}$ at $-50^{\circ}C$ .

Abstract: A commercially feasible sodium-ion pouch cell with a capacity of 650 mAh is fabricated using the ternary layered $\mathrm{Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_2}$ and the hard carbon as the cathode and anode materials, respectively. $1.0\mathrm{MNaPF}_6$ in the mixed carbonate solvents is served as the electrolyte. citations.quote: In summary, a commercially feasible sodium-ion pouch cell with $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon is fabricated in this work. According to the calculation of the frontier molecular orbital energy, the electrolyte additive adiponitrile (ADN) is selected as the electrolyte additive to improve the performance of sodium-ion battery for the first time, and the effects of the ADN on the performance improvement of the cathode material $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ are investigated for the first time. The results show that ADN can promote the formation of highly conductive and stable SEI film on the cathode material surface, and effectively improve the high-low-temperature performance and cycling stability of $Na_{0.76}Ni_{0.3}Fe_{0.4}Mn_{0.3}O_{2}$ as the cathode electrode material of sodium-ion batteries. In particular, the battery with 3% ADN shows the most obvious improvement, its discharge capacity increases by 10.5%, 8%, and 13% at the operating temperature of 45, -10, and -20 °C, respectively. For the cycling stability, the capacity retention rate of the battery without adding ADN drops rapidly to 75% after 40 cycles, while the capacity retention rate of the battery with 3% ADN can still reach 78% after 220 cycles. Adding ADN as electrolyte additive effectively improves the electrochemical performance of sodium ion batteries.

3.5. Enhanced electrochemical performance of HC anode
To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

# 电解液正向设计 Skill

当性能段已经引用具体子图，但缺少电极或电池类型时，可在
`enrich_formulation_evidence` 的 request 中设置 `include_figure_context: true`。
工具沿同篇论文的明确图号、子图补取图注。筛选保留性能段和图注两个出处，
不会把图注中其他子图的温度、倍率或循环数补到当前性能结果上。
同论文、相邻段落或同一种盐本身不能证明属于同一组试验。

## 任务要求与测试类型

整理配方前，先检查候选是否报告了用户要求的温度、倍率和电池配置下的结果。
标题相关或正文分别出现这些条件，不代表同一次试验满足全部条件。
先补取与目标工况相符的性能段，再整理对应配方的浓度、比例和添加剂用量。
若已选候选缺少目标条件下的结果，应检查本轮检索返回的其他候选，
不要围绕同一候选重复查询，或把另一温度下的表现当作目标条件的结果。

先把用户明确要求的条件写入 `constraint_records`，不要在筛选过程中增加用户没有
提出的性能要求。放电容量、倍率性能和循环寿命是不同测试。用户要求某温度、某倍率
的放电结果时，不将缺少同温度、同倍率的循环寿命结果记为阻断缺口。
`unresolved_gaps` 应对应候选组成缺失或用户必需条件，额外研究建议写进验证计划。
若原文已经明写倍率与电流的对应关系，应引用该原句，不将它再次列为缺失。
用户给出的数值与单位须原样保留在至少一个检索查询中，包括括号内的电流或容量。
不能用倍率替换具体电流后就认为已经检索了全部条件。具体标识未命中时先核查
原标识的字面检索结果，再继续扩展候选；不由系统填写论文名称或配方。
在形成候选前，逐项检查用户目标是否已有相关证据。近似温度是选材目标，仍需
优先考察接近该目标的实际测试结果；室温表现不能替代高温或低温使用依据。
近似目标没有容差时不虚构数值阈值。报告必须写出文献实测条件，并在 next_steps
交代目标条件下的验证；不能省略这个目标后把基础配方写成完整解决方案。
成本等定性目标也逐项说明已有依据和待验证事项，不能随硬条件通过而消失。
联合条件的 `electrode` 只写正负极材料，`cell_configuration` 单独写软包、扣式等
电池类型，不把两种信息混写在一个字段中。

## 适用场景

- 用户要求设计适用于特定工况（低温、高压、长循环等）的钠离子电池电解液；
- 用户提供多套候选配方要求评分筛选。

## 证据能力选择

检索查询根据当前用户问题生成，使用英文。先检索用户给出的电极对、电池形式、
温度、倍率或电流及目标性能，不预先限定用户没有指定的盐、溶剂或添加剂。
可把这些条件拆成多个查询，用 `search_literature_multiview` 合并结果；
不必在每个查询中同时塞入所有条件。用户给出的具体电流、容量或电压范围也可用来
定位相关实验，不能只用宽泛的“低温电解液”替代这些信息。
对于有辨识度的电极缩写、明确电流或容量，`resolve_literature_papers` 可补充
字面检索。向量结果未覆盖这些具体标识时，先用原标识检查字面命中，避免继续
围绕不符合电极或电流条件的论文扩展检索。使用用户原本给出的标识，不猜作者或题名。先查看返回的正文命中，
再决定是否值得进行论文内检索；无关的引用、另一种电池的结果不能用于推荐。
找到相关论文后，使用论文内检索分别取得组成、测试条件和性能，核对是否属于
同一配方与同一测试。机理或替代体系检索用于解决实际缺口，不是必做的检索次数。
参数建议：`top_k=10`，`per_query_top_k=8`，`max_per_paper=2`。
盐未指定时，不要只锚定向量检索第一次命中的盐：先用 `kg_query` 的
`find_materials_for_condition`，把 `material_types` 设为 `["SodiumSalt", "Electrolyte"]`，
查目标温度/条件下测试过的盐与电解液，再对返回的具体盐名逐个补向量检索。
双盐体系必须用「dual salt + 具体盐名」组合查询才能召回，单独查一个盐名往往召不回对应论文。
后续查询依据已有结果和 `DecisionState.evidence_gaps` 调整。

## 工作流

### 逆向设计例外：先诊断，筛选仅决定能否推荐配方

对于容量骤降、首圈库仑效率低、高压衰减、阻抗增长等 `inverse_design` 问题，先从检索证据中建立至少两个可区分的电解液侧假设，并提出能区分它们的 EIS、Raman、XPS、LSV、ICP、产气或对照实验。仍执行候选配方筛选，但筛选 `hold` 只禁止“推荐进入实验”的完整配方；不得因此省略诊断、混杂因素和条件化调整方向。报告必须区分“已被证据支持的诊断事实”与“待验证的调整方向”。

1. 解析用户目标与约束；把用户要求的每项条件写成结构化 `constraint_records`，例如：
   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。
   推荐前逐项核对用户要求与检查条件，避免漏掉正极、负极、电池形式、温度、倍率或指标定义。
   检索前先解释用户给出的数值条件：它描述什么物理量、单位如何理解、哪些信息尚不明确。
   这一解释依据用户描述的工作场景，在检索前定下，不能由后来检索到的论文或知识图谱记录
   反过来改写；其它论文里恰好出现同样的 “N C” 写法，只说明那些论文的用法，不能用来判断
   用户这句话。
   温度与倍率的单位必须分清。省略度符号的 C 不能直接视为充放电倍率。
   按它在句中的位置判断：直接修饰电芯、电池或其使用环境时（如 “a pouch cell at -30 C”、
   “a full cell around 50 C”），是温度；只有与充放电动作或倍率词连用时
   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，
   此时暂缓推荐，而不是把两种解释同时写成两条互斥的数值约束。
   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们
   同时写成必需的 `required_component`；每个选项应作为独立候选分别比较，不叠加互斥的必需组分。
   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，
   用现有 `evidence_claim` 表达候选须有相应工况下的直接测试依据，而非把近似目标
   改成精确相等、单边不等式或自行设定容差。逐候选判断时，`supported` 须引用该
   候选的实际测试条件与性能原句，`basis` 写清实测条件与目标的差别及其关联依据。
   只有其他工况的结果、测试建议或机理预测时，不能据此判近似工况要求已满足。
   没有相应测试依据就保留 `not_found` 并补证，不能删掉该要求后批准推荐，再把它
   放进 `next_steps`。有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的
   差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列。电极、电池形式和其他明确要求仍须检查。
   联合条件也须保留近似目标的含义：不得把近似值写成 `target_context` 中要求
   精确匹配的数值。近似工况及其电极、全电池归属可写在同一 `evidence_claim`
   中，引用实际共同测试的结果；组分身份等与工况无关的要求不并入该测试条件组。
   “低成本”等定性目标须区分文献提出的成本动机与已量化的价格优势；未提供价格数据
   时不得称已验证低成本。数值明确的用户要求仍按原值建立硬约束，不得因此放宽。
   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`

   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成

   ```json
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "solvent-thf",
           "description": "THF as solvent",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "THF",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find THF solvent evidence"
         }
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。
messages.name: load_skill

messages.content: I'll begin by setting up the task plan, then execute the evidence-acquisition workflow.

additional_kwargs.reasoning_content:
Let me understand the task:

Design an evidence-acquisition workflow to select an electrolyte intervention for improving initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) after formation in a -20°C hard-carbon||layered-oxide sodium-ion pouch full cell.

Key constraints:
- Target: improve initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) after formation
- Condition: -20°C
- Cell: hard-carbon anode || layered-oxide cathode
- Full cell: pouch
- Sodium-ion

Let me set up a todo list and start the workflow.

Sodium ion batteries are attracting extensive interest due to their low cost and abundant sodium resources. However, sodium ion batteries still suffer from severe performance degradation at low temperatures due to the conflict between ion desolvation and diffusion. Herein, we design a co-intercalation ether electrolyte to achieve solvent co-intercalation in the hard carbon negative electrode, thereby bypassing the slow desolvation process while ensuring rapid ion diffusion in electrolyte and hard carbon. To elucidate the specific effects of NaTFPB additive on anode performance, a series of electrochemical performance tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material. Fig. 5a illustrates the rate capability of HC in different electrolyte systems. Specifically, at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the system employing NaTFPB electrolyte exhibited an exceptional discharge specific capacity of $310\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , significantly surpassing the $211\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ capacity of the Base electrolyte system. As the current density increased to $500\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the Base electrolyte dropped dramatically to below $30\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . In contrast, the NaTFPB electrolyte system demonstrated remarkable stability, maintaining a high discharge capacity of $174\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , far exceeding the performance of the Base electrolyte. More notably, when the current density was reduced back to $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity of the NaTFPB electrolyte system almost fully recovered to $306\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ . Furthermore, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the cycling performance of HC anodes in different electrolytes at a current density of $30\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ (Fig. 5b). The results demonstrated that the NaTFPB electrolyte system exhibited exceptional cycling steadiness, maintaining a discharge specific capacity of $226.75\mathrm{mAh}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ after 100 cycles, which significantly outperformed the capacity of the Base electrolyte (144.04 mAh $\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ ) under the same number of cycles. Additionally, it is noteworthy that the Base electrolyte suffered from excessive consumption of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ during its formation process, resulting in an initial coulombic efficiency (CE) of only $60.40\%$ (Fig. 5c). The introduction of the NaTFPB additive effectively improves the utilization efficiency of active $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ , thereby significantly enhancing the initial coulombic efficiency of the HC anode to $72.40\%$ (Fig. 5d).

"battery with NaDFP remains 871 mAh, 838 mAh, and 798 mAh at 0.3C, 0.5C and 1C where battery without NaDFP only remains 756 mAh, 712 mAh, 695 mAh at -20°C. Even at -30°C, discharge capacity at 1C of the battery with NaDFP remains 688 mAh, where baseline only remains 459 mAh."

Formation protocol: "First charge the SIBs at room temperature to 2.0 V, then charge them at 45 °C (0.5 MPa) with a current of 90 mA to 3.8 V."

So this candidate:
- Salt: NaPF6 0.8 M ✓
- Solvent: EC:EMC = 3:7 ✓ (ratio basis unknown — actually the paper says "EC: EMC = 3:7" without basis; the KG candidate marked "unknown". Careful.)
- Additive: NaDFP 1 wt% ✓
- Cell: NFM (layered O3 oxide) || HC pouch ✓ — layered oxide + hard carbon pouch full cell ✓
- Temperature: -20 °C discharge tested ✓ ; -10 °C cycling ✓
- **ICE after formation: increased from 84.69% to 88.89%** ✓ — this is the ICE measure after formation! Though the temperature at which ICE is measured — likely at room temperature (25 °C) during the formation/initial cycle. Formation is at RT then 45 °C.

Hmm — is the ICE improvement measured at -20 °C? The paper says "the initial Coulombic efficiency of the battery is increased from 84.69% to 88.89%, which means that capacity loss of the battery reduced after Formation." The formation is at RT→45°C. So ICE improvement is demonstrated but at the formation temperature (RT/45 °C), NOT at -20 °C. And the -20 °C data are discharge capacities, not ICE.

So: the electrolyte intervention does improve ICE after formation in an HC||layered-oxide pouch full cell — strongly matching structurally (pouch, HC, layered oxide NFM, NaPF6/carbonate). But the ICE measurement temperature is the formation temperature, not -20 °C. The -20 °C evidence is discharge capacity.

This is exactly the kind of nuance the skill wants: "有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列."

Now, does ICE need to be measured at -20 °C? The user says "improving initial Coulombic efficiency after formation in a -20 C hard-carbon||layered-oxide sodium-ion pouch full cell". Interpretation: the cell operates at -20 °C; formation/ICE is a cell-level metric. Arguably the ICE would be measured during formation, which typically occurs at or near room temperature. Hmm. But the user specified the cell as "-20 C ... pouch full cell", so the target operating temperature is -20 °C. Whether ICE must be measured at -20 °C is ambiguous.

The honest approach: treat the ICE improvement claim as requiring direct evidence in the target cell type, and treat the -20 °C condition as a temperature constraint requiring evidence at/near -20 °C. Then:
- Candidate NaDFP: ICE improvement shown (84.69→88.89%) in NFM/HC pouch; -20 °C discharge performance shown in same pouch cell/electrolyte. Both in the same paper and same cell system. Temperature: the -20 °C evidence exists but the ICE itself was not measured at -20 °C.

Should the temperature constraint (at -20 °C) be satisfied by the -20 °C discharge test in the same cell? The skill requires: "温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该 observation 的 condition_scope 和 joint_context_requirements 表达" and "联合条件的 electrode 只写正负极材料". And the joint context must be satisfied by an experiment where the constraints are jointly instantiated. The ICE observation is at formation temperature (RT/45°C); the -20 °C observation is discharge capacity. So a joint group {temperature=-20, ICE claim} would NOT be jointly satisfied → the joint_context_requirement would fail → gap.

Hmm. That's the crux. The skill instructs: if no joint instantiation, the group fails and creates a gap → likely hold, OR the group requirement is "can_replan".

But also, the skill says not to delete the requirement, and if only other-condition results exist, keep `not_found` and re-plan, and put the verification in next_steps.

Hmm, but that would force a hold for everything, which may be correct here. But is it the right reading? Let's reconsider: The user's request is essentially "select an electrolyte intervention for improving ICE after formation in a -20 °C ... pouch full cell". An intervention = an additive/electrolyte change. The target: ICE improvement. The cell: HC||layered-oxide pouch, operating at -20 °C.

The best-matching evidence is Cai 2024 (NaDFP): ICE improved after formation in exactly this cell type, and the same cells/electrolyte were tested at -20 °C. That is a genuinely strong, evidence-backed selection. The residual gap is that the ICE itself was not measured at -20 °C (it was measured after formation), and the pouch cell's -20 °C data are discharge capacities rather than Coulombic efficiency.

I think the right, defensible decision: **recommend** the NaDFP intervention, but with an explicitly scoped claim: the ICE improvement (84.69%→88.89%) was reported after formation in an NFM‖HC pouch cell with the same electrolyte, and separately -20 °C discharge performance was reported for the same cell/electrolyte. claim_verdicts.quote: Due to the addition of NaDFP, the initial Coulombic efficiency of the battery is increased from $84.69\%$ to $88.89\%$
claim_verdicts.basis: 同篇论文同体系：该原句报告加 NaDFP 后电池化成后的首圈库仑效率由 84.69% 升到 88.89%；该论文的配方段说明电池为 NFM(层状氧化物)||硬碳软包全电池，故该 ICE 提升属于软包全电池化成后的结果。
检索到的 CIE 首圈库仑效率仅为 Na||HC 扣式半电池在 25 °C（93.7%）与 -50 °C（80.5%）的值；软包全电池只报告容量/比能与 -20 °C 容量保持率，未见软包全电池化成后的 ICE 提升证据。
原文只报告 3% ADN 使 -20 °C 放电容量提升 13% 及循环保持率改善，未报告化成后首圈库仑效率。
原文的 ICE 提升（60.40%→72.40%）来自硬碳半电池（Na||HC 扣式），并非硬碳||层状氧化物软包全电池化成后的结果。

evidence_chunks.content: EC, EMC, and sodium flurophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), sodium difluorophosphate (NaDFP) provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The electrolyte was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in a mixture of EC: EMC = 3:7, and this electrolyte was assigned as baseline electrolyte. NaDFP was added to the baseline electrolyte to prepare. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd and Hard Carbon were purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. Pouch cells were assembled using an NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1C), a hard carbon (HC, 290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05C) anode, and a Celgard 2700 membrane as the separator. NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid were dispersed in N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. evidence_chunks.content: This result is consistent with our speculation that the reaction between solvent and salt are restrained by NaDFP. Due to the addition of NaDFP, the initial Coulombic efficiency of the battery is increased from $84.69\%$ to $88.89\%$ , which means that capacity loss of the battery reduced after Formation (a process for stabilizing electrode interfaces). Meanwhile, the NaDFP additive decreases the gas production of pouch cells after Formation, as shown in Fig. 1f. Previous studies had shown that the gas generated during formation was mainly from the decomposition of organic solvents, these kind of decompositions always generate a number of by-products which deposit on the surface of the electrode and are harmful to the cycling stability [14]. Notably, the CV (half-cell Na-HC) area of NaDFP is significantly smaller than the Baseline one, inconsistent with the performance of pouch SIBs after formation (Fig. 1e) and following test. The reason for different performance between Na-HC half coin cell and NFM/HC pouch cell is displayed in Fig S2 and these again prove the importance of using pouch cell for battery performance evaluation. In order to evaluate the electrolyte physical properties changes after inducing NaDFP, the concentration of NaDFP effects on viscosity and conductivity at room temperature was studied firstly. Fig. 2a shows the relationship between conductivity, viscosity and additive concentration at 25 °C.

As shown in Fig. 3e-3 h, battery with NaDFP remains 871 mAh, 838 mAh, and 798 mAh at 0.3C, 0.5C and 1C where battery without NaDFP only remains 756 mAh, 712 mAh, 695 mAh at $-20\ ^{\circ}C$ . Even at $-30\ ^{\circ}C$ , discharge capacity at 1C of the battery with NaDFP remains 688 mAh, where discharge capacity at 1C of the battery with baseline electrolyte only remains 459 mAh. Different from being successfully applied in LIBs, EC is not suitable with SIBs. Because it is easily oxidized on the cathode during the cycling, especially under high voltage or high temperature, which oxidates the lattice oxygen on the surface of the cathode material to produce active $\left(\mathrm{O}_{2}\right)$ species that attacked the solvent molecules, thus resulting in the loss of lattice oxygen and the consumption of the electrolyte [18]. Continuous lattice oxygen loss can lead to an irreversible phase transformation. High temperature cycling and high voltage cycling were followed to confirm the function of the cathode electrolyte interphase (CEI) induced by NaDFP. As shown in the Fig. 4a and 4b, the cycling stability and rate performance at 45 °C were improved. As a recent upstart in the field of energy storage, the energy storage efficiency of SIBs under high temperature conditions is one of the main research focuses.

## 配方筛选结果
获得文献支持的候选：cand-1-NaDFP。

### 候选资料：cand-1-NaDFP（通过筛选）
以下为候选记录中的组成，配制时须核对所引原文的比例基准与用量。
盐：NaPF6；浓度：0.8 mol L⁻¹；NaPF6：0.8 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：EC, EMC；溶剂比例（基准待核对）：EC=0.3, EMC=0.7；添加剂：NaDFP；添加剂用量：NaDFP=1 wt% (optimal; saturation above 1 wt%)。
- 配方原文 [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4::child0]：EC, EMC, and sodium flurophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), sodium difluorophosphate (NaDFP) provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The electrolyte was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in a mixture of EC: EMC = 3:7, and this electrolyte was assigned as baseline electrolyte. NaDFP was added to the baseline electrolyte to prepare. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd and Hard Carbon were purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. Pouch cells were assembled using an NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1C), a hard carbon (HC, 290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05C) anode, and a Celgard 2700 membrane as the separator. NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid were dispersed in N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The areal loading of the anode and cathode was 16 g m $^{-2}$ and 33 g m $^{-2}$ , respectively.

## 候选评估
### cand-1-NaDFP
评估建议：The candidate matches the paper's electrolyte (0.8 M NaPF6, EC:EMC 3:7, 1 wt% NaDFP) tested in hard-carbon||layered-oxide pouch full cells, and the paper directly reports an ICE increase after formation (84.69%→88.89%) plus improved -20 °C discharge capacity, supporting this intervention for the stated goal. No recorded computations were needed or available; the decision rests on literature evidence for this candidate.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: 0.8 M NaPF6 in EC:EMC = 3:7 (the candidate's salt, concentration, and solvent ratio)：The paper prepares exactly 0.8 M NaPF6 dissolved in an EC:EMC = 3:7 mixture as the baseline electrolyte, matching the candidate's salt/concentration/solvent-ratio identity. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4::child0]
- Additive NaDFP added at 1 wt%, stated to be the optimal concentration：The work adds NaDFP to the baseline and states 1 wt% is optimal because saturation occurs above 1 wt%, matching the candidate's additive and amount. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child6]
- Hard-carbon || layered-oxide sodium-ion pouch full cell format：The electrolyte is tested in NFM (layered oxide) cathode / hard-carbon anode pouch cells assembled with 10 cathodes and 11 anodes, matching the required full-cell configuration. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4::child0][0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4::child1]
- -20 °C operation of the target full cell：Batteries with 1 wt% NaDFP were discharge-tested at -20 °C (and -30 °C), retaining 871/838/798 mAh vs 756/712/695 mAh for baseline, and the paper notes larger low-temperature gains than at room temperature. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child8]
- Improvement of initial Coulombic efficiency after formation：Adding NaDFP raises the initial Coulombic efficiency from 84.69% to 88.89% and reduces gas production after formation, i.e., less capacity loss after formation. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child3]
文献与候选的关联：The candidate composition (0.8 M NaPF6 in EC:EMC = 3:7 with 1 wt% NaDFP) is the exact electrolyte reported for NFM/HC pouch full cells. On these cells the paper reports the ICE gain after formation and the -20 °C discharge performance, so the ICE and low-temperature evidence are tied to the same candidate electrolyte and cell format; the half-cell CV discrepancy is explicitly noted and the paper argues the pouch-cell measurement is the relevant one. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4::child0][0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child3][0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec8::child1]
### cand-2-CIE
评估建议：The candidate matches the study's designed CIE exactly (0.8 M NaPF6, G2:MO 7:3 vol), which is shown in the target HC||NFM pouch format at -20 °C and gives the highest HC ICE among the compared electrolytes; the only gap is that ICE at -20 °C in the pouch was not directly reported, so the recommendation is based on the exact composition match plus low-temperature pouch and half-cell ICE evidence.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte is 0.8 M NaPF6 dissolved in a G2:MO = 7:3 vol solvent mixture (no additives).：The Materials section states the CIE was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF6 in G2:MO = 7:3 vol%, exactly matching the candidate's salt, concentration, solvents, ratio and basis; no additive is mentioned. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec7]
- Target cell is a hard-carbon (HC) || layered-oxide sodium-ion pouch full cell.：The pouch-cell section describes a 1.2 Ah pouch cell assembled with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode, i.e. the requested HC||layered-oxide pouch full-cell configuration. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0]
- Operation at -20 °C.：The pouch-cell section reports cycling performance of the CIE pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles, confirming -20 °C operation in the target cell. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0]
- Electrolyte improves the initial Coulombic efficiency (ICE) of hard carbon.：In Na||HC cells CIE delivers the highest first-cycle ICE (93.7%) versus CCE (87.7%) and WSE (91.4%) at 25 °C, supporting an ICE-improving property of this electrolyte (measured in half cells). [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec3::child0]
- ICE improvement demonstrated at -20 °C specifically in the HC||layered-oxide pouch full cell after formation.：ICE values are reported only for Na||HC half cells (93.7% at 25 °C; 80.5% at -50 °C), while the -20 °C pouch data report capacity retention, not ICE; no explicit statement transfers the half-cell ICE to the -20 °C pouch after formation. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec1::child3][0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0]
文献与候选的关联：The composition (sec7) and pouch-cell format/temperature (sec6) belong to the same study and electrolyte; however, the ICE measurement (sec3) was made on Na||HC half cells at 25 °C/-50 °C, whereas the -20 °C target condition in the HC||NFM pouch reports only capacity retention. The paper does not explicitly establish that the half-cell ICE transfers to the -20 °C pouch, so the ICE evidence associates only partly with the target condition. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec7][0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0][0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec3::child0]
### cand-3-ADN
评估建议：The candidate formulation matches the reported 1.0 M NaPF6/EC:DEC:PC + FEC + 3% ADN electrolyte in the same hard-carbon||layered-oxide pouch cell and shows -20 C performance benefits, but the paper does not report initial Coulombic efficiency after formation; the specific target metric remains unverified, so recommendation is held pending ICE evidence.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaPF6 at 1.0 M concentration：The paper states the electrolyte is 1.0 M NaPF6 in mixed carbonate solvents, matching the candidate salt and concentration. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec2::child0][0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec3::child6]
- Solvent system is a carbonate mixture of EC, DEC, and PC：The introduction explicitly describes 1.0 M NaPF6 in the mixed solvent of EC:DEC:PC, matching the candidate's three solvents. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec3::child6]
- ADN is added as an electrolyte additive at 3%：The conclusions identify the battery with 3% ADN as showing the most obvious improvement, confirming 3% ADN as the studied additive amount. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec8::child0]
- FEC is present as a basic additive：The text states FEC is used as the basic additive alongside 1.0 M NaPF6 in EC:DEC:PC. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec3::child6]
- Cell format is a hard-carbon || layered-oxide sodium-ion pouch full cell：The abstract states a 650 mAh sodium-ion pouch cell is fabricated with Na0.76Ni0.3Fe0.4Mn0.3O2 cathode and hard carbon anode, matching the target full-cell configuration. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec2::child0][0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec5::child0]
- Cell is evaluated at -20 C operation：The conclusions report discharge capacity increases at -20 C with 3% ADN, and figure captions list -20 C discharge profiles, establishing -20 C as a tested condition. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec8::child0]
- The intervention improves initial Coulombic efficiency after formation：The paper reports discharge capacity increases, cycling retention, and SEI composition (TEM/XPS) but does not report any initial Coulombic efficiency value or its improvement after formation, so the target metric is not evidenced. 
文献与候选的关联：The candidate's electrolyte (1.0 M NaPF6 in EC:DEC:PC with FEC and 3% ADN) is the studied electrolyte in the paper's 650 mAh Na0.76Ni0.3Fe0.4Mn0.3O2/hard-carbon pouch cells, and the -20 C and cycling measurements are performed on those full pouch cells after cell assembly and charging/formation described in the battery assembly section. [0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec5::child0][0061_Song 等 - 2018 - The effects of the functional electrolyte additive on the cathode material Na076Ni03Fe04Mn03O2 f::sec2::child0]
### cand-4-NaTFPB
评估建议：The candidate formulation exactly matches the paper's optimized NaTFPB electrolyte and is directly supported for improving HC-anode initial Coulombic efficiency (60.40% to 72.40%), but the target requires a -20 C hard-carbon||layered-oxide pouch full cell, and no low-temperature or full-cell/pouch evidence is provided. The decision is therefore held pending evidence at the target temperature and cell format, rather than recommending the candidate outright.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Salt is NaPF6 at 1.0 mol/L (candidate identity condition)：The source states the Base electrolyte is prepared by dissolving NaPF6 (1.0 mol/L) in EC/DMC, matching the candidate's salt and concentration. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec5]
- Solvent is EC:DMC at a 1:1 mass ratio：The source specifies an EC and DMC mixture at a mass ratio of 1:1, matching the candidate's solvent_ratio_basis = mass. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec5]
- FEC co-additive at 5.0%：The Base electrolyte contains 5.0% fluoroethylene carbonate, matching the candidate's FEC amount. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec5]
- NaTFPB additive at 1.0 wt%：The paper investigates various NaTFPB concentrations and standardizes the concentration to 1.0 wt% based on performance, matching the candidate's 1.0 wt% NaTFPB. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec11]
- Anode is hard carbon：Electrochemical tests were conducted using hard carbon (HC) as the anode material, matching the target anode. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec14]
- Intervention improves initial Coulombic efficiency after formation：The Base electrolyte gave an initial CE of only 60.40%, and adding NaTFPB improved the HC anode initial CE to 72.40%, directly addressing ICE enhancement. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec14::child1]
- Cathode is a layered oxide (NFM111)：The NaTFPB effect was tested on the NFM111 layered-oxide cathode, establishing relevance to the layered-oxide cathode side, though only in NFM111||Na half-cells. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec11]
- Validated in a hard-carbon||layered-oxide pouch full cell：The reported measurements use HC||Na and NFM111||Na half-cells, not a hard-carbon||layered-oxide pouch full cell; no full-cell/pouch result is provided and no explicit transfer argument is given. [0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec11][0024_Hu 等 - 2025 - Bifunctional sodium tetrakis 35-bistrifluoromethylphenyl borate additive for long-lifespan sodi::sec14]
- Demonstrated or transferable at -20 C operating temperature：None of the provided chunks report low-temperature (-20 C) testing; all cycling/ICE data are given without a -20 C condition, so the low-temperature requirement is not addressed. 
文献与候选的关联：The candidate composition (NaPF6 1.0 M, EC:DMC 1:1 mass, 5.0% FEC, 1.0 wt% NaTFPB) identically matches the paper's optimized Base+NaTFPB electrolyte, so the HC-anode ICE improvement (60.40% to 72.40%) is associated with the exact candidate formulation. However, that ICE gain is measured on an HC half-cell, and no low-temperature or full-cell/pouch data are given, so the association holds for formulation identity and HC ICE but not for the -20 C pouch full-cell target.
